request.description: Get all public posts with pagination, filterable by tag, author_id, role, or search keyword.
Get personalized feed for logged in user containing posts from followed students/teachers/parents and self.
Create a new post. The author role (student, teacher, parent, admin) and author identity are automatically determined from the Bearer token.

header.description: Optional: provides is_liked and is_bookmarked flags

request.description: Retrieve a single post by ID including likes count, bookmarks count, and author information.
Get the list of all students/teachers/parents who liked the post.
Update post content, title, tags, or media. Only post author or admin is allowed.
Delete post. Only post author or admin is allowed.
Toggle like on post: likes if not yet liked, unlikes if already liked.
Toggle bookmark on post for the logged-in user and saves it to user bookmarks.
Share an existing post to your own followers, referencing the original post.
